title: Review an action dependency
prompt: Document how you would review an action owner, source, inputs, outputs, release practices, and immutable pin.
objective: Demonstrate the behavior of review an action dependency and capture verifiable evidence.

starter.code:
name: Reusable action step
on: workflow_dispatch
permissions:
  contents: read
jobs:
  example:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Run a small check
        run: echo "Check completed"

expected_output: A reviewed workflow or design note satisfying: uses:, SHA, inputs. Verify behavior on a disposable repository where execution is required; a static sketch is not proof of a live deployment.
acceptance_criteria: Explain one validation result or limitation.
Do not include a real secret or use production resources.
hints: First identify the trigger, input, and expected result.
Start with read-only permissions and a disposable branch or test environment.
Compare your result with the linked lesson and official documentation; distinguish a configuration sketch from a live integration.

solution.explanation: The detailed reference solution is stored in a protected repository-only JSON file; it is not intended for a learner-facing response.

grading_method: Server-side required-string smoke check plus human review for workflow semantics and security boundaries.
retry_policy: Allow retries; incorrect submissions do not award XP. The platform awards exercise XP only after server-verified successful completion and applies idempotency per activity.
status_note: Source mapping: Course reinforcement practice; original learning task adapted to CodeLeaf structure. Starter example aligned with its linked lesson; review and replace any remaining repository-specific placeholders.
